question: Which FOLLOWUPS.md items should become tasks in the radical-observability-g2-b2 (plugin 2.0.99) plan? #197: parent folders on the way to decisions.ndjson aren't checked for links; B8 rewrites that exact read, so checking them costs little. #186: a bot-style mergedBy login refuses the merge line; current code already appears to write merge-unknown in that case, so the build would only add a test confirming it.

options.label: #197 only (Recommended)
options.description: Add a link check on the parent folders when B8 reads decisions.ndjson (active or completed). Same theme, small.

options.label: #186 too
options.description: Add a test confirming a bot login gives a local merge-unknown line, and close the item if it passes.

options.label: None
options.description: Keep 2.0.99 to B7, B8 and B9 exactly as designed.

question: Plugin 2.0.99 ship gate, round 2: the security audit and the pen test both found that a repo can commit a folder .oss/dev/completed/<feature>-<later date>/, with a date later than the real archive or equal to today. The merge timeline line then files there, and that folder's committed decisions.ndjson approves the merge. A second, related finding: the 'no later than today' check uses the local clock and time zone, so clock skew moves the cut-off. Both belong to the P-17 class you already decided (a repo can plant decision ids in its committed record; the API flags them when it reads). Keep both under P-17 and log them in FOLLOWUPS, or fix them in this release?

options.label: Keep under P-17 (Recommended)
options.description: Log both in FOLLOWUPS as a wider route for P-17. The API's read-time flag covers the planted decision. 2.0.99 ships with the timeline fix only.

options.label: Fix now
options.description: Before shipping, also check that the archived folder is one this branch created (for example via git history or a marker), plus a clock-skew guard. This means more code and another gate round.

question: Plugin 2.0.99 scope: the API session's ADR-018 (your picker 'Separate pen-test agent', today) says 2.0.99 also adds agents/penetration-tester.md (B10). That's a copy of the 145-line security-auditor wrapper with its names changed, fetching the pen-test prompt the API already serves. This branch doesn't have it yet; its gates are done and it is ready to commit. Phase C's ship falls back to security-auditor on a plugin without the wrapper, but its pen-test timeline lines then show as unverified. Add B10 to 2.0.99 now, or ship 2.0.99 as is and put B10 in 2.0.100?

options.label: Add B10 to 2.0.99 (Recommended)
options.description: One wrapper file plus a test, built test-first, then a narrow gate check on just that file. Phase C gets both B7 and B10 from one release, as ADR-018 planned. Roughly one more round before the PR.

options.label: Ship 2.0.99 now, B10 in 2.0.100
options.description: Keeps this release to one theme (the timeline archive fix). Phase C can ship on 2.0.99, but pen-test lines show as unverified until 2.0.100.
